name: Aviation Plaza
summary: Aviation Plaza is a professionally managed shopping center in Linden, New Jersey, operated by Milbrook Properties, a family-owned firm with nearly a century of real estate expertise. The center serves the Union County community with convenient retail and service options along West Edgar Road.
demographics: Aviation Plaza serves a diverse middle-income demographic in Linden, New Jersey, primarily attracting families and working professionals from the surrounding Union County area. The trade area includes a mix of suburban households with median incomes ranging from $60,000 to $85,000, with shoppers typically aged 25-54 seeking convenient access to everyday services and retail. The center draws from a densely populated corridor along Route 1, benefiting from high traffic counts and serving both local residents and commuters who value accessibility and practical shopping options.
description: Aviation Plaza is a well-established shopping center located at 601-901 West Edgar Road in Linden, New Jersey, strategically positioned to serve the Union County community. Managed by Milbrook Properties, a family-owned real estate company with nearly 100 years of experience and five generations of expertise, the center benefits from professional property management that emphasizes hands-on service and tenant relationships. Milbrook Properties' commitment to excellence is evident in their weekly property visits, detailed monthly reports, and proactive maintenance approach that ensures the center remains well-maintained and responsive to tenant needs. The property management team prides itself on being on a first-name basis with tenants, providing the kind of personalized attention that creates a stable and thriving retail environment. With a strong 4.4-star rating from nearly 6,000 reviews, Aviation Plaza has established itself as a reliable shopping destination along the busy West Edgar Road corridor, offering convenient access to a variety of retail and service options for the local community.
